title: Quick Festive Brazilian Leek Skewers
description: Fresh and pillowy Brazilian dish featuring leek, perfect for festive occasions, cooked to perfection in a fondue pot using a bain-marie method.

ingredients.name: leeks
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the fondue pot using a bain-marie method to a temperature of 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together leeks, butter, garlic, salt, and black pepper until the leeks are well coated.
Thread the leek mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the fondue pot and cook for 10 minutes or until the leeks are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together coconut milk and lime juice.
Pour the coconut milk mixture over the cooked leeks and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Repeat the cooking process for the remaining leek skewers.
Serve the leek skewers hot with additional coconut milk sauce for dipping.
